description: This file defines the 'Setting' model class within the Opencart e-commerce framework, handling database interactions for settings retrieval and management.

classes.name: Setting
classes.description: A model class for managing store configuration settings in OpenCart.

methods.name: getSettings
methods.description: Retrieves all setting records for a specified store ID.

methods.name: getSetting
methods.description: Fetches specific settings identified by a code for a given store.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Fetches a particular setting value by key and store ID.
